meta.title: Vattenkraftverk i Sverige - Gratis nedladdning
meta.description: Hydro power generation/storage units in Sweden (182 of 662), carved from sv-kraftverk by the native `fueltype` field. Verbatim subset of the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes and cross-referenced upstream source IDs. Innehåller 182 poster. Ladda ner i Excel, CSV, PDF format.
meta.seo_description: Ladda ner Vattenkraftverk i Sverige — 182 poster. Tillgänglig i Excel, CSV, PDF format.
key_takeaways: Gratis nedladdning i Excel, CSV och PDF format
